item.title: Another legislative session chipping away at gun rights (Letters)
item.description: Sen. Sullivan wants to make it unlawful to purchase a barrel for your existing firearm, unless it is in person through a licensed gun dealer.

item.title: Lindsey Vonn’s father tells the AP he wants her to retire after her Olympic crash
item.description: Lindsey Vonn’s father said Monday that the American superstar will no longer race if he has any influence over her decision and that she will not return to the Winter Olympics after breaking her left leg in the downhill over the weekend.

item.title: Cherry Creek Schools’ freeze on travel, contracts tied to ‘decisions and actions’ of former superintendent and his wife
item.description: Board President Anne Egan announced that interim Superintendent Jennifer Perry will launch an external audit to review the district's organizational systems, including internal controls and fiscal responsibilities.

item.title: National Laboratory of the Rockies, based in Golden, axes another 134 positions
item.description: The National Laboratory of the Rockies let go 134 employees on Monday, the second time in less than a year that the facility formerly known as the National Renewable Energy Laboratory, or NREL, has terminated staff.

item.title: Denver OKs first $410M in Vibrant Denver bonds as agencies give AAA ratings — with a caveat
item.description: The ratings came with a gentle warning: They could consider downgrading the city’s grade if its rainy day fund doesn’t recover soon.

item.title: Christian Braun on failed initial return from ankle injury: ‘I wasn’t ready’
item.description: White men can't jump if their ankles aren't fully healed, Christian Braun learned recently.

item.title: Keeler: Broncos need to give RB Breece Hall what he wants, a Super Bowl ride on Bo Nix Express
item.description: Why Breece Hall? The Broncos are on the right track. They just need more beef in the boxcar.

item.title: Fight between Pistons and Hornets results in 4 players being ejected
item.description: Charlotte’s Moussa Diabate and Miles Bridges were tossed, along with Detroit’s Jalen Duren and Isaiah Stewart.

item.title: James Harden, Donovan Mitchell make clutch plays, Nuggets cough up late lead to Cavs
item.description: The Nuggets let a double-digit lead slip away in the fourth quarter, as the new-look Cavaliers swept the season series against Denver.
